parrafo.es: The Best Friend Pet Grooming lleva un trailer de grooming totalmente equipado hasta tu casa en Homestead. Ruben atiende perros y gatos, con calma y atención individual, sin jaulas ni esperas en un salón.
parrafo.en: The Best Friend Pet Grooming brings a fully equipped grooming trailer straight to your home in Homestead. Ruben works with dogs and cats, calm and one-on-one, no cages and no salon waiting room.

parrafo_1.es: The Best Friend Pet Grooming es un servicio de grooming móvil con base en Homestead, a cargo de Ruben. En vez de subir a tu mascota al carro y esperar en un salón, el trailer completamente equipado llega hasta tu entrada.
parrafo_1.en: The Best Friend Pet Grooming is a mobile grooming service based in Homestead, run by Ruben. Instead of loading your pet into the car and waiting in a salon, the fully equipped trailer pulls right up to your driveway.

parrafo_2.es: Perros y gatos reciben el mismo trato calmado y atento, incluso las mascotas más nerviosas. Esa paciencia sostiene la calificación de 5.0 en Google con 18 reseñas.
parrafo_2.en: Dogs and cats get the same calm, attentive handling, even the most nervous pets. That patience backs up the 5.0 rating on Google from 18 reviews.

items.quote: We tried Best Friend Pet Grooming and were very happy with the service and professionalism. He arrived on time and was very welcoming to our Yorkie who is very nervous, we feel his calm demeanor helped.

The best mobile dog groomer! One of my dogs used to hate baths, and now he literally runs out into our groomer's arms when he comes. Super professional and fair prices. We have 3 frenchies and they recommend him.
Ruben did an amazing job grooming my cats! Highly recommend!!
